summary: An investigation was initiated following an analyst request to examine card losses lacking shared device telemetry. Review of card C01727-K2 revealed three unauthorized online product-C charges totaling $967.68 sent to recipient domain sc.rr.com between January 17 and January 28, 2017, breaking an established baseline of strictly in-person transactions. Legitimate card-present charges continued in region 231 concurrently with the online transactions, demonstrating card-not-present compromise. Graph analysis linked these transactions to an emerging multi-card scheme where 16 other cards directed payments to the same recipient domain over the preceding 30 days. The card has been blocked, connected cards placed on monitoring, and a regulatory report filed.
open_question: The common point of compromise across the 17 cards targeting sc.rr.com remains unknown; merchant breach data or common point of purchase analysis would identify the compromised merchant source.

waiting.why: 3a: the fraud connects to 16 other card(s), which is a connection to another customer's fraud
